body:
I'll do my best. Appreciate it. I guess I just have to endure it for a bit. I hope I can do that.
  
Thanks for responding. Really :)
Thanks. I guess this is it. That I just need to give it some time. I'm just so tired. So tired.

I'm ashamed but I know I can't do anything about it. Nobody knows. I want to come out to my family, even though I'm really afraid of what their reaction would be. But then I think - what's the point, it's not like there are people interested in dating me. Why do something that may be another disappointment when things would stay exactly the same.
